releaseNotes: Standardized the installed add-in folder as RA BIM [STR] for Revit 2025, 2026 and 2027.
Kept the unified RA_BIM_STR assembly while updating every packaged manifest to resolve RA BIM [STR]\RA_BIM_STR.dll.
The detached updater now removes obsolete RA_BIM_STR and RA_BIM_2027 deployment folders after a successful replacement.
Rebuilt the Rebar Map Beam section preview from the actual matching Revit beam width and depth.
Concrete, cover, stirrup diameter and longitudinal-bar diameters now share one real section scale.
Add Top and Add Bottom bars now align to their nearest main-bar row instead of using a separate fixed spacing.
Equal main/add quantities align exactly; smaller additional layers select evenly mirrored main-bar positions.
Support Add Top and Mid Add Bottom layouts now mirror cleanly through the section depth.
The preview footer now reports the detected real B x H section size.
Added manual two-dot inner-tie picking to the Rebar Map section canvas for both Column and Beam profiles.
Column inner ties now reuse the proven RB Column bar-key and real tie creation engine.
Beam profiles now save independent Support and Mid inner-tie groups and reuse the proven RB Beam inner-tie engine.
Added a Support/Mid preview selector and Clear Picks command for Beam inner ties.
Inner-tie picks persist inside each Rebar Map profile and are applied by Create Selected, Create All and Refresh RB.
Added safe key migration when bar quantities change so stale canvas picks cannot target the wrong bar.
Added a saved Top bend length (mm) input to Rebar Map Column profiles.
The configured bend length is applied automatically to the topmost column when Auto detect column above finds no continuation.
Existing profiles migrate safely to a 250 mm top bend when no valid value was previously stored.
Fixed Check Update so the external installer survives after Revit closes instead of being terminated with the host process.
The package is now verified and extracted before shutdown, then installed immediately after every Revit process closes.
Added protection against reopening Revit before the staged add-in folder has been replaced.
Added a clear Save, Close, Wait and Reopen instruction after the download completes.
Check Update now selects the matching 2025, 2026 or 2027 package from the unified manifest automatically.
Reworked Magic RB and Refresh RB Column with an automatic three-stage stack: foundation-anchored stump column, cranked middle-storey continuation and inward top bend.
The lowest column now anchors only when an actual overlapping structural foundation is detected; the unsafe blind/manual embedment fallback has been removed.
Columns with a real column below start at their own base with Auto Crank and never inherit foundation anchorage from the stump column.
Columns with a real column above continue by the configured D lap; the topmost column automatically bends inward because no upper column exists.
Added Column Engine V4 migration so existing managed column profiles refresh once with the corrected automatic stack classification.
Fixed Refresh RB so the intentional duplicate host Mark warning used by Rebar Map profiles no longer interrupts batch generation.
Applied the focused warning filter to create, tag, reconcile and cleanup transactions while preserving unrelated warnings and every Revit error.
Fixed Magic RB Column upper lap so the continuation is never shorter than max(Manual, Minimum, Lap Factor x bar diameter).
Fixed duplicate Rebar Mark warnings by keeping profile grouping in Partition and assigning an element-unique Mark.
Added a Column Engine revision migration so existing profile-managed column bars refresh once and receive the corrected lap and Mark data.
Fixed the temporary "identical rebar in the same place" warning during Column Profile refresh.
The fix suppresses only the transient duplicate-rebar warning while the incremental reconciler reuses/deletes candidate bars.
Unrelated warnings and all Revit errors remain visible.
Added Rebar Engine V2 Pro Max shared lifecycle for Beam, Column, Slab and Foundation.
Added native host-constraint locking and versioned host fingerprints for newly created reinforcement.
Upgraded Profile Map so Column geometry changes are detected like continuous Beam context changes.
Upgraded Refresh RB with non-destructive V2 audit and changed-host selection.
Preserved manually edited reinforcement and kept the automatic dynamic updater disabled.
Reorganized source folders by Architecture/Structure tab, numbered panel and numbered tool.
Added in-product Check Update for the OneDrive Stable release channel.
Added installed/latest version comparison and release notes in the update window.
Added SHA-256 package verification before installation.
Added a safe external installer that waits for Revit to close and rolls back on failure.
Updated About to show the installed product version and update channel.
Hidden Drawing and Quantity panels for testing.
